representation: MODRISS JSON DSL mapped to SPEM 2.0

roleDefinitions.name: Product Owner
responsibilities: Product goal, ordered backlog, value decisions, acceptance

roleDefinitions.name: Delivery Lead
responsibilities: Team coordination, dependencies, flow metrics, escalation, retrospectives

roleDefinitions.name: Domain Expert
responsibilities: Validates that architecture still realizes business scenarios

roleDefinitions.name: Solution Architect
responsibilities: Service boundaries, contracts, integration, policies, readiness

roleDefinitions.name: Quality Engineer
responsibilities: Contract, integration, quality-attribute, and evidence strategy

roleDefinitions.name: Security Engineer
responsibilities: Identity, authorization, data protection, and security review

roleDefinitions.name: Cloud Platform Engineer
responsibilities: Provider constraints, deployability feedback, and platform handoff

taskDefinitions.name: Plan service slice
steps: Select one service slice traced to CIM goals, bounded contexts, and behavior.
Record scope boundaries, architectural risks, manual transform decisions, and definition of done.
Confirm the expected PIM EVL gate and review participants for the cycle.
entryCriteria: CIM transform complete, prior PIM increment selected, or greenfield PIM
exitCriteria: Service-slice scope and definition of done are agreed

taskDefinitions.name: Create PIM model root
steps: Create or verify PIMModel with domain linkage to CIM source.
Set modeling date, lifecycle status, and annotation conventions.
exitCriteria: PIMModel root exists

taskDefinitions.name: Set architecture posture
steps: Configure ImplementationProfile with serverless posture and platform assumptions.
Select ArchitectureStyle and document key architectural decisions.
exitCriteria: Architecture style and profile configured

taskDefinitions.name: Establish shared model contract and evidence conventions
taskDefinitions.purpose: Establish shared model contract and evidence conventions
steps: Apply shared identity, annotation, traceability, expression, and lifecycle conventions across PIM elements.
Record the revision, transformation provenance, and review-state convention for the service slice.
Keep support concepts in inspectors and readiness evidence instead of exposing them as false deployable architecture nodes.
exitCriteria: Shared model contract and evidence convention are recorded

taskDefinitions.name: Define serverless services
steps: Create ServerlessService elements aligned to CIM bounded contexts.
Set boundary type and ownership scope per service.
exitCriteria: Services defined for increment slice

taskDefinitions.name: Assign element memberships
steps: Create ServiceElementMembership links from services to planned elements.
Set OwnershipKind for each membership.
exitCriteria: Memberships cover deployable boundaries

taskDefinitions.name: Define schemas and fields
steps: Create Schema elements with fields and enum literals.
Set schema kind and field types aligned to CIM information items.
exitCriteria: Schemas cover API and message payloads

taskDefinitions.name: Model event types and envelopes
steps: Define EventType and EventEnvelope elements from CIM events.
Apply validation constraints and compatibility rules.
exitCriteria: Event contracts aligned with CIM behavior surface

taskDefinitions.name: Model data stores and models
steps: Create DataStore and ObjectStore elements per service.
Define DataModel and DataField structures from CIM entities.
exitCriteria: Stores and models cover domain data

taskDefinitions.name: Define access patterns and indexes
steps: Model AccessPattern elements from CIM queries and commands.
Define IndexCandidate and DataAccess bindings per store.
exitCriteria: Access patterns cover read/write use cases

taskDefinitions.name: Configure change streams and notifications
steps: Define DataChangeStream elements for event-sourced projections.
Configure ObjectNotificationRule for object store triggers.
exitCriteria: Change streams linked to event contracts

taskDefinitions.name: Define functions and contracts
steps: Create Function elements with FunctionContract bindings.
Set compute profile and execution model per handler.
exitCriteria: Functions mapped to CIM commands and queries

taskDefinitions.name: Configure triggers and runtime
steps: Define Trigger elements linking functions to events and schedules.
Set runtime language and package manager per function.
exitCriteria: Triggers cover behavioral entry points

taskDefinitions.name: Define APIs and routes
steps: Create Api elements with routes and HTTP methods.
Connect routes to function handlers.
exitCriteria: API routes cover public endpoints

taskDefinitions.name: Map API contracts and errors
steps: Bind ApiContract elements to schema definitions.
Map ErrorMapping responses to CIM business errors.
exitCriteria: Contracts and error mappings complete

taskDefinitions.name: Model event channels and buses
steps: Create EventChannel, Queue, Topic, and EventBus elements.
Set delivery semantics and ordering requirements.
exitCriteria: Channels cover async integration points

taskDefinitions.name: Define flows and routing rules
steps: Model Flow variants connecting producers and consumers.
Define EventRoutingRule and Subscription bindings.
Configure Schedule triggers for periodic integration.
exitCriteria: Flows connect integration endpoints to functions

taskDefinitions.name: Model workflows and states
steps: Create Workflow elements from CIM business processes.
Define typed workflow steps, transitions, and workflow kind.
exitCriteria: Workflows cover long-running CIM processes

taskDefinitions.name: Configure human tasks and error handling
taskDefinitions.purpose: Configure human tasks and error handling
steps: Add HumanTask and ApprovalTask elements with escalation policies.
Define CompensationPolicy and ErrorHandler for failure paths.
exitCriteria: Human steps and error paths orchestrated

taskDefinitions.name: Configure identity providers and principals
steps: Define IdentityProvider elements aligned to CIM actors.
Register Principal elements for human and service identities.
exitCriteria: Identity model covers all actor types

taskDefinitions.name: Define permissions and security policies
steps: Create Permission elements with effect and action kind.
Apply AuthPolicy and AuthorizationPolicy to APIs and functions.
exitCriteria: Auth model covers all public endpoints

taskDefinitions.name: Apply resilience policies
steps: Define ResiliencePolicy on functions and integration flows.
Configure RetryPolicy, DeadLetterPolicy, and TimeoutPolicy per target.
Set IdempotencyPolicy for state-changing handlers.
exitCriteria: Resilience policies applied to critical paths

taskDefinitions.name: Configure throughput and ordering policies
steps: Set ConcurrencyPolicy and RateLimitPolicy on APIs and functions.
Configure BatchPolicy, OrderingPolicy, and CachePolicy where needed.
Apply BackupPolicy, RetentionPolicy, and CostPolicy to stores.
exitCriteria: Throughput and cost policies configured

taskDefinitions.name: Configure observability policies
steps: Define ObservabilityConfig per service.
Apply LoggingPolicy, MetricPolicy, and TracingPolicy to functions and APIs.
exitCriteria: Observability baseline configured

taskDefinitions.name: Define alerts, SLOs, and CORS
steps: Create AlertPolicy and Slo elements for critical endpoints.
Apply CorsPolicy to public API routes.
exitCriteria: Alerts and SLOs cover critical paths

taskDefinitions.name: Apply governance and compliance policies
steps: Define ArchitecturePolicy and PolicySetting elements.
Apply DataProtectionPolicy and CompliancePolicy from CIM governance.
exitCriteria: Governance policies linked to data and APIs

taskDefinitions.name: Map business rules and decision models
taskDefinitions.purpose: Map business rules and decision models
steps: Create BusinessRule elements from CIM policies.
Model DecisionModel with DecisionRule rows for branching logic.
exitCriteria: Business rules linked to functions and workflows

taskDefinitions.name: Model external endpoints and adapters
steps: Create ExternalEndpoint elements from CIM external systems.
Define ExternalAdapter bindings to integration flows.
exitCriteria: External integrations modeled

taskDefinitions.name: Configure environments and deployment units
steps: Define Environment and DeploymentUnit elements per stage.
Configure ConfigurationSet, secrets, and credential requirements.
Set ConfigParameter and EnvironmentVariable values per environment.
exitCriteria: Environments and config complete for slice

taskDefinitions.name: Assess platform capabilities
steps: Review PlatformCapability coverage against modeled elements.
Complete PlatformMappingAssessment with gap analysis.
exitCriteria: Platform mapping assessment documented

taskDefinitions.name: Complete trace and readiness
steps: Build TraceModel links across CIM and PIM elements.
Complete ProductionReadinessAssessment and resolve findings.
exitCriteria: PIM EVL passes; readiness gate approved

taskDefinitions.name: Review and adapt PIM increment
steps: Review architecture outcomes against CIM trace links and PIM definition of done.
Record accepted scope, deferred architecture decisions, and platform mapping feedback.
Create improvement actions and backlog adjustments for the next service slice.
entryCriteria: PIM EVL passes or all blocking findings are dispositioned
exitCriteria: Increment accepted or rework loop selected; improvement actions captured

workProductDefinitions.name: PIM Increment Plan
workProductDefinitions.description: Selected service slice, trace baseline, and architecture definition of done

workProductDefinitions.name: PIM Increment Review Record
workProductDefinitions.description: Architecture review outcomes, accepted service slice, and improvement actions

guidance.name: Service as deployable boundary
guidance.text: Align ServerlessService boundaries to CIM bounded contexts. One increment typically maps to one service slice.

guidance.name: Generated PIM is a draft
guidance.text: Treat CIM→PIM output as architectural scaffolding. Every generated service slice must pass through framing, refinement, readiness, and review before PIM→PSM.

guidance.name: Contracts decouple producers
guidance.text: Define schemas and event types before wiring functions and routes. Contracts are the integration currency.

guidance.name: Access patterns drive stores
guidance.text: Model read/write access patterns from CIM queries/commands before choosing store topology.

guidance.name: Policy attachment discipline
guidance.text: Attach resilience, observability, and compliance policies to concrete PolicyTarget elements, not free-floating rules.

guidance.name: Readiness is part of delivery
guidance.text: Platform mapping and EVL validation are not after-the-fact audits. They are the review gate of each service-slice cycle.

sourceOfTruth: The project work tracker stores one process-run record per increment or release candidate.
The model repository stores the model revision, transformation run, validation evidence, and readiness assessment.
The release record stores the exact accepted model, generator, artifact, test, and deployment revisions.

aggregation.rule: Aggregate by increment, team, release, and product; never average away a blocking finding.
aggregation.teamCoordination: Publish a shared dependency board with ownership, dependency type, due date, and escalation path.
aggregation.reviewCadence: Daily local coordination, per-increment review/retrospective, and per-release readiness review.

metrics.name: Eligible task completion
metrics.cadence: each workday and at gate review
metrics.interpretation: Visibility only; never substitute for a usable increment.

metrics.name: Increment flow time
metrics.interpretation: Use trends to tune slice size and expose queues.

metrics.name: Rework rate
metrics.formula: reopened tasks caused by a finding / completed tasks
metrics.interpretation: Inspect causes; do not use as an individual performance score.

metrics.name: Trace coverage
metrics.formula: accepted scope items with source-to-evidence trace / accepted scope items
metrics.cadence: at every level gate and release
metrics.interpretation: A low value blocks confidence even when task completion is high.

metrics.name: Open blocking findings
metrics.interpretation: Must be zero or covered by an explicit, time-bound risk acceptance.

metrics.name: Manual decision closure
metrics.formula: accepted/rejected/waived manual decisions / blocking manual decisions
metrics.interpretation: Open decisions remain visible and are not silently treated as done.

metrics.name: Behavior-to-contract coverage
metrics.formula: accepted commands, queries, and events with a reviewed PIM contract / selected behavior elements
metrics.interpretation: Prevents architectural task completion from hiding contract gaps.

metrics.name: Unresolved platform ambiguity
metrics.formula: open PlatformMappingAssessment or ManualDecision records blocking PSM transformation
metrics.interpretation: Must trend down before PIM promotion.

governance.gate: PIM-to-PSM promotion requires an explicit user/model semantic-validation review; generated PIM is scaffolding until the solution architect accepts or rejects each material decision.

processEngine.description: Revolves through service-slice framing → contracts/data → compute/API → integration → assurance → readiness per service slice.

deliverable.name: PIM increment slice
deliverable.description: Runnable serverless architecture for one service boundary.

loop.guidance: After the phase-embedded review/adapt stage, revolve the PIM engine for the next service slice.

reworkLoops.name: Contract Gap Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Function contracts reference undefined schemas or event types.
reworkLoops.guidance: Complete contracts, then update function bindings.

reworkLoops.name: Data Access Rework
reworkLoops.trigger: Functions need stores or access patterns not yet modeled.
reworkLoops.guidance: Extend data architecture, then replay compute tasks.

reworkLoops.name: API Contract Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: API routes need schemas or error mappings not defined.
reworkLoops.guidance: Complete contracts, then remap API routes.

reworkLoops.name: Integration Topology Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Channels reference producers/consumers not defined as functions.
reworkLoops.guidance: Add compute targets, then rewire integration topology.

reworkLoops.name: Security Coverage Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Public endpoints lack principals or auth policies.
reworkLoops.guidance: Identify unprotected resources; add security bindings.

reworkLoops.name: Policy Ripple Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Policies require integration or compute changes.
reworkLoops.guidance: Apply policy targets on integration/compute elements.

reworkLoops.name: PIM Readiness Rework
reworkLoops.trigger: PIM EVL or platform mapping reveals blocking gaps.
reworkLoops.guidance: Jump to earliest affected assurance stage; replay to readiness.

processEngine.spemMapping: MODRISS extension realized as an Activity(kind = Iteration) containing process Activities and WorkSequences.

entryCriteria: CIM transform complete, prior PIM increment selected, or greenfield PIM
exitCriteria: PIM root configured

Services cover deployable boundaries for the slice

workflows.name: Rescope Service Boundary
workflows.trigger: ServerlessService membership or ownership must change.
steps: Adjust ServiceElementMembership and ownership on affected deployable elements.
Replay Capability Core stage for moved elements (contracts, data, compute, API).
Re-run integration topology and assurance phases for cross-service flows.
Update platform mapping assessment before PIM→PSM.

workflows.name: Evolve Contract Version
workflows.trigger: Schema or event type needs breaking or compatible change.
steps: Set SchemaCompatibility and version annotations on Schema/EventType.
Update all FunctionContract, ApiContract, and route payload references.
Apply data migration assumptions in TransformationProfile if needed.
Re-validate integration subscriptions and access patterns.

workflows.name: Attach or Change Policy
workflows.trigger: New resilience, observability, or compliance policy applies to existing elements.
steps: Create ArchitecturePolicy and PolicySetting targets.
Verify PolicyTarget elements exist and are correctly linked.
Run policy EVL suite; replay assurance stage if attachments span services.

workflows.name: Post-Transform PIM Change
workflows.trigger: PIM must change after PSM or artifacts exist.
steps: Apply PIM change with impact analysis on trace links to CIM and PSM.
Re-run PIM EVL and readiness.
Re-execute PIM→PSM ETL; review platform mapping deltas.
Regenerate M2T artifacts; run deployment dry-run.
